t: An open hardware Linux board with Gigabit Ethernet and a built-in battery charger.
steps: Buy the A64-OLinuXino-1G from Olimex or DigiKey.
Get a 5 V power supply with a DC jack and a microSD card.
Download an Olimage Linux image from the Olimex wiki.
Flash the image to the microSD card with a free card flashing app.
Connect an HDMI monitor, a USB keyboard, and an Ethernet cable.
Power the board and log in to Linux.
Install Python and run a short script that prints the board temperature.
Read the Olimex wiki page on the GPIO header before wiring sensors.
meta: Wild Open. From $50.54. A few stores.
